operation_details.item: The user's Q3 roadmap focuses on the mobile app.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! I saw you blocked time this afternoon for roadmap planning. What's the top priority for Q3?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We're still sorting through a few moving pieces. I want to make sure we're building the right thing for our users.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Have you settled on the core focus for the quarter?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The Q3 roadmap focuses on the mobile app.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Mobile-first makes sense given your user base. What else is in the pipeline?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The roadmap also includes the API expansion.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should help with integrations. How are you deciding what makes the cut?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Customer feedback is prioritized in the roadmap.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great approach. It's easy to get caught up in shiny ideas, but listening to customers keeps you grounded.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I've seen too many founders pitch perfect slides but ignore the people actually using the product.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Do you have a regular cadence for revisiting the roadmap as things change?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The roadmap is reviewed every week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a solid habit. Weekly reviews let you pivot quickly without losing sight of the quarter's goals.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Right. We keep the reviews tight and focused on execution, not just polish. Thanks for helping me think through this.
